source_summary: Wide handscroll-style Chinese river landscape with misty water, distant shoals, boats, willow groves, rocky banks, a wooden bridge with tiny figures, and a partially hidden riverside village among trees.

motifs.name: distant_left_shoals
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant sandbars and low ink-wash banks across the upper-left water, including the horizontal grey-brown washes, soft mist gaps, and tiny dotted reed or vegetation marks.
must_preserve: clusters of tiny stippled reed dots
blurred mist edges fading into blank water

motifs.name: left_river_boats
motifs.description: Isolate the group of boats on the left river: the larger roofed passenger boat near the upper center-left and the smaller skiffs below and around it, with surrounding blank water kept only as needed for the hull silhouettes.
must_preserve: brown roof and cabin geometry on the large boat
small oar strokes and skiff profiles
tiny dark passenger or boatman marks

motifs.name: foreground_lotus_dots_left
motifs.description: Isolate the low foreground water surface and bank at the lower left, with dense dotted lotus/reed texture and the dark soft-edged mound emerging from the water.
must_preserve: dense stippled lotus or reed dots
soft dark wash of the foreground mound
scattered pale water gaps between dots

motifs.name: central_left_willow_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the left portion of the central riverside grove: rounded willow masses, small shrubs, low rocks, and the dotted marshy bank beneath them.
must_preserve: fine branch linework visible through wash
soft transitions between trees and misty water

motifs.name: central_tall_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central grove with high willow trunks, arching branches, dark foliage washes, exposed roots, and clustered rocks at the base.
motifs.role: dominant central tree and rock mass
must_preserve: gnarled root lines at the base
angular rock texture and contour strokes

motifs.name: bridge_with_walkers
motifs.description: Isolate the long wooden bridge crossing the lower middle-right water, including its railings, posts, angled approach, small supports, and tiny walking figures on the span.
must_preserve: small pier supports beneath the span
dark ink accents along the bridge edges

motifs.name: right_willow_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side riverbank grove beside the bridge: leaning willows, tangled bare branches, exposed roots, low rocks, and the undulating bank below.
must_preserve: gnarled trunks and exposed root network

motifs.name: far_right_village_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the far-right wooded village area, with buildings partially hidden among dark trees, distant low mountains at the top, and the rocky shoreline and shrubs below.
must_preserve: faint roof and wall geometry behind trees
soft mist bands separating background and village
rocky shoreline contours and stippled vegetation

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
